**4.1 Verification of the Voter List**

The draft voter list was published on 2021-03-10. Claims and objections were received until 2021-03-17, 6:00 PM. A total of 14 claims and 3 objections were received. All claims and objections were scrutinized by the Election Committee on 2021-03-19 at the Society Office. All 3 objections were upheld, and the names of the concerned members were removed from the list.

- Share certificate and application form

- No proxy voting was permitted, except in the case of Members who had authorised a representative in writing, as per the Election Rules. A total of 3 proxy votes were cast.

The polling concluded at 6:00 PM. The ballot boxes were sealed in the presence of the candidates and their authorised representatives. The seals were signed by the Presiding Officer, the candidates present, and the authorised representatives.
